newsitem.title: USA: Authentic Fitness names president, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Authentic Fitness names president, CFO.

text.p: Authentic Fitness Corp Tuesday named Christopher Staff to the position of president and chief operating officer.

In a statement, the company also named Wallis Brooks to the post of senior vice president and chief financial officer and appointed James Robbins as president of the Authentic Fitness Retail Stores Division.
The company said Staff rejoins Authentic Fitness Corp, having previously held senior positions at the company's Speedo Division for over 20 years. His position is a newly created position.

Brooks, who was senior vice president and chief financial officer of Authentic Fitness from 1993 to 1995, replaces Nikki Sohl, who is leaving for personal reasons. Robbins, who was vice president and general merchandise manager of a division of Sports and Recreation Inc prior to joining Authentic Fitness, replaces Sergio Moroni, who also is leaving for personal reasons.
